owner_split.agent_team: Owns all app/agents sources, prompts, graphs, schemas and tool protocols. No agent source changes in this integration.
owner_split.backend: Owns scoped store implementations, boundary adapters, durable workers and HTTP APIs under app/features/work_cases. Calls public agent entry points/protocols; never changes app/agents prompts, graph, schemas or role limits.

execution: Graph opt-in: START -> INFO_EXTRACTOR -> CANDIDATE -> user candidate selection and policy-controlled drafts; review opt-in: REPLY -> INFO_EXTRACTOR -> INFO_PRIORITY -> RESPONSE_PLAN -> COUNTER_OFFER and card staging, PLAN -> RESPONSE_PLAN -> COUNTER_OFFER and card staging. Graph owns branching/rechecks; backend owns persistence, scope, deadlines, approval and actual dispatch.

persistence.START: graph_start.json: scoped quote/run/document/private candidate-draft staging and graph completion
persistence.candidate_selection: candidate_selection.json: per-case user selection, selected-only publication, preserved mailbox limits and retirement of unused proposals
persistence.REPLY_PLAN_CARD: graph_review.json: review draft/card staging, guarded completion, pending outbound resolution and immutable review history
persistence.quote_record: Full QuoteVersionRecord; pricing tiers, cost terms, tax checks, item notes, evidence, normalized mail and conditions retained.
persistence.privacy: AgentRunner final next_action/reason/unknown_fields retained at agent_runs.output_jsonb top level. Raw partial tool-call payloads are discarded.
persistence.atomicity: DB-owned transactional RPCs; no independent REST calls pretending to be one transaction. Stage a card before final commit so graph revision checks remain valid; never mark Complete with unresolved DRAFT/SENDING/UNKNOWN.

run_scope: Authenticated owner + durable job + revision + batch; ContextVar-scoped store proxy, not mutable per-user global stores.
privacy: Disable tracing; never persist AgentRunner raw partial_tool_calls or log mail/model payloads.
requirements: Existing Supabase store/job RPCs must match the documented backend contract; definitions are managed by the DB owner.
Existing REGISTERED/VERIFIED_WEB suppliers; no auto supplier creation. Unmatched supplier follows team HOLD behavior.
Requested purchase quantity is not supplier available_quantity and is not invented from it. Company label uses verified registered supplier name.
AgentRunner role-specific model/reasoning config is preserved. Provider retries disabled and per-request timeouts bounded by backend run deadline.
status: Backend graph/store/worker implementation and offline verification completed; DB-owned graph/candidate/review RPC deployment, frontend live wiring and real end-to-end validation remain. No app/agents changes in this PR.

public_interfaces.rule: Use existing public protocols only. Propose and agree interface changes with the agent team before modifying their sources; no new public agent interface introduced here.

backend_implementations.REPLY_PLAN: infrastructure/review_graph_store.py: comparison/priority/counter-offer/card stores and owned historical evidence
backend_implementations.worker: application/graph_worker.py and infrastructure/graph_repository.py: guarded durable scheduling, lease/revision checks, final acknowledgement validation

legacy_extraction_only.scope: Used only when AGENT_GRAPH_ENABLED=false; not the new graph contract or a restriction on roles 2-5. Existing deployed legacy RPCs stay unchanged.
legacy_extraction_only.execution: Call AgentRunner(INFO_EXTRACTOR, ExtractionIn) directly. No graph option/override and no roles 2-5.

persistence.quote: Full QuoteVersionRecord; pricing tiers, cost terms, tax checks, item notes, evidence, normalized mail and conditions retained.
persistence.atomic_quote_rpc: store_case_agent_quote: quote + optional reference-price history + mail normalization + case conditions + workflow log in one transaction.
persistence.completion_rpc: complete_case_agent_extraction: verify case/revision/batch/lease and stored quote IDs, then terminal run + case step + log.
persistence.partial_failure: QuoteStore is a commit-on-tool contract. A quote already committed by a successful tool call remains immutable if later model/final-output validation fails. The job is then FAILED, never silently Complete.
persistence.json_mapping: DB object-shaped cost_terms_jsonb/item_notes_jsonb store items arrays; pricing_terms_jsonb.agent_record retains the exact agent record for lossless readback.
persistence.decimal: All scalar NUMERIC projections read as text; SQL rejects >6 meaningful decimal digits instead of rounding. MOQ and order increment are paired with units.
persistence.currency: Base v3.6 allows KRW only. Foreign-currency records are rejected, never converted or relabeled.
persistence.role_output: AgentRunner final next_action/reason/unknown_fields retained at agent_runs.output_jsonb top level. Raw partial tool-call payloads are discarded.
persistence.run_metadata_rpc: begin_case_agent_run: records model/prompt and scoped input on existing job before model invocation; final role result remains top-level.

legacy_extraction_only.status: Connected and validated with 47 offline checks: real team AgentRunner/FakeModel + isolated PGlite SQL; real provider deployment remains unverified.

tool_limits.authority: Agent team feature/agents TOOL_CALL_LIMITS, not backend enforcement
tool_limits.note: Agent sources remain identical to PR base. Agent team merges its TOOL_CALL_LIMITS implementation separately; backend adds no role-limit override.

settings.AGENT_GRAPH_ENABLED: false by default selects legacy extraction-only mode; true needs graph_start.json functions
settings.AGENT_GRAPH_REVIEW_ENABLED: false by default; true additionally needs graph_review.json functions and graph mode
settings.external_effects: No enabling, live Gmail/LLM calls, schema migration or direct SQL installation in this integration.

runtime_policy_override.source: 2026-11-04 PR41 review correction; supersedes previous runtime override
runtime_policy_override.policy: No temporary AGENT switches and no duplicate backend role lists. Graph START worker is optional: unavailable config/interfaces/DB/startup leaves API and mail receiver running. START follows the public graph through role2; no extraction-only fallback.
runtime_policy_override.claim: Only claim_case_graph_run(p_start_from=START). Unified START/REPLY/PLAN claim and review scheduling deferred until DB owner agreement; not called by this runtime.
runtime_policy_override.steps: Steps follow the deployed DB work_cases_check5 (2026-11-05) and agent schemas.ProcessingStep. Running graph steps: EXTRACTING (INFO_EXTRACTOR), SELECTING_CANDIDATES (CANDIDATE running), GENERATING_PLANS (INFO_PRIORITY/RESPONSE_PLAN/COUNTER_OFFER). CANDIDATES is the post-graph user-selection wait set by complete_case_graph_run. Terminal: REVIEW_READY/ON_HOLD/FAILED. BUILDING_PLANS and BUILDING_COUNTER_OFFER are not written (DB rejects them).
runtime_policy_override.deployment: After DB functions are deployed restart server to attach graph worker; missing graph does not prevent mail/API startup. API START still requires readiness/live worker. /ready reports mail readiness and degraded review separately.
